e.zb: 由我們擔任代理人，讓您的專利帶來收入，並取得您在台灣所需的授權。

e.b: Make your patents earn, and secure the licences you need in Taiwan with us.
e.zb: 讓您的專利帶來收入，也協助您取得在台灣需要的授權。

e.b: We license your Taiwan patents to local suppliers, integrators and operators, turning them into royalty income and negotiating leverage, and making local assembly and supply-chain partnerships run more smoothly.
e.zb: 把您的台灣專利授權給在地供應商、整合商與使用單位，轉為權利金收入與談判籌碼，也讓在地組裝與供應鏈合作更順利。

e.t: We find the patent owner and close the licence
e.b: If a review finds your technology falls within someone else's patent, we find the owner, whether a research institute, a university or a local company, and negotiate the licence terms with you so your product can launch. Taiwan has no estab
e.zt: 替您找到權利人，談成授權
e.zb: 若評估發現您的技術落入他人專利，我們替您找出權利人，包括研究機構、大學與在地廠商，並協助談判授權條件，讓產品順利上市。台灣目前缺少專利授權的中介，這一步由我們替您完成。

e.t: License patent cover in bundles of 30
e.b: Self-serve licensing for makers who need patent cover in a market without negotiating patent by patent. The platform is not open yet; tell us your market and we will contact you when it is.
e.zt: 以 30 件為一組，取得專利授權保護
e.zb: 自助式授權，適合需要在特定市場取得專利保護、又不想逐件談判的製造商。平台尚未開放；告訴我們您的市場，開放時我們會與您聯絡。

e.b: UAV patents and applications filed by TIS and by Innovue, in product-technology fields. Available for licence whether or not you use our MRO services.
e.zt: TIS × Innovue 無人機專利組合
e.zb: 由 TIS 與 Innovue 申請的無人機專利與申請案，屬於產品技術領域。無論您是否使用我們的 MRO 服務，皆可取得授權。

e.b: We'll walk your IP counsel through the portfolio, or scope licensing for your own patents. NDA available.
e.zt: 與我們的授權窗口聯絡。
e.zb: 我們會向您的智財法務完整說明這組專利組合，或為您自有的專利規劃授權。可簽署保密協議。

e.t: An ecosystem, activated as your program grows
e.b: TIS is the single contract, the program manager and the SLA owner. Partners bring service capacity, UV capability and patent data.
e.zt: 隨您的專案成長而啟用的生態系
e.zb: TIS 是唯一的合約方、專案管理者與 SLA 負責人。夥伴提供服務量能、無人載具能力與專利資料。

e.b: Nine companies across five business lines and an island-wide dealer network. As a licensed importer, PG Union runs customs, homologation and controlled-goods coordination every day.
e.zb: 九家公司、五大事業線，以及全台經銷網路。作為合格進口商，PG Union 每天處理通關、型式認證與管制品協調。

e.b: Taiwan leading UAV manufacturer, contracted to train, certify, equip and audit TIS service partners as they reach UV grade.
e.zt: 台灣領先無人機製造商
e.zb: 台灣領先無人機製造商，受託為 TIS 服務夥伴提供培訓、認證、工具設備與稽核，協助其達到無人載具等級。

e.b: The IP-technology backbone behind Protect and License: database, analytics and monitoring, and a co-applicant on the UAV patent portfolio.
e.zb: 防護與授權服務背後的智財技術骨幹：資料庫、分析與監測，並為無人機專利組合的共同申請人。

e.t: Start with a 30-minute conversation under NDA.
e.b: Tell us your platform and fleet size. We’ll show you which partners your program activates first.
e.zt: 從一場 30 分鐘、在保密協議下的會談開始。
e.zb: 告訴我們您的平台與機隊規模，我們會說明您的專案會先啟用哪些夥伴。

e.b: Demand for unmanned systems in Taiwan is arriving faster than the capacity to sustain them, and 9 of 16 leading foreign UAV makers hold no Taiwan patents.
e.zt: 為何是台灣，為何是現在
e.zb: 台灣對無人載具的需求，到來的速度快過維運量能；而主要外國無人機製造商，16 家中有 9 家在台灣沒有任何專利。

e.t: Demand is arriving faster than sustainment capacity.
e.zt: 需求到來的速度，快過維運量能。

e.b: The Armaments Bureau is buying 11,270 aircraft in 2026 and 37,480 in 2027, multi-award, with no PRC-origin components and domestic components preferred.
e.zb: 軍備局 2026 年採購 11,270 架、2027 年 37,480 架，採多家決標，不得使用中國製零組件，並優先採用國產零組件。

e.b: NT$44.2 bn coordinated by the Ministry of Economic Affairs to build the domestic UV industry.
e.zt: 無人載具產業發展計畫
e.zb: 經濟部統籌 442 億新台幣，發展國內無人載具產業。

e.b: Passed in May 2026 with an NT$780 bn ceiling. Its UAV and counter-UAS systems are bought through foreign military sales, so foreign makers will field systems in Taiwan that need local sustainment.
e.zb: 2026 年 5 月通過，上限 7,800 億新台幣。其中的無人機與反無人機系統經由對外軍售採購，因此外國製造商將在台灣部署需要在地維運的系統。

e.b: 9 of 16 leading foreign UAV makers hold no Taiwan patents. Once systems are fielded they get studied, and without Taiwan filings a maker has no position against local imitation and no leverage with local suppliers.
e.zb: 主要外國無人機製造商，16 家中有 9 家在台灣沒有任何專利。系統一旦部署就會被研究；沒有台灣專利，製造商就無法對抗在地仿製，也沒有與在地供應商談判的籌碼。

e.t: What a foreign maker needs, and who offers it today
e.zt: 外國製造商需要什麼，今天由誰提供

e.b: Automotive dealers with no UV competence, or aerospace shops with no island-wide network.
e.zb: 沒有無人載具能力的汽車經銷商，或沒有全台網路的航太維修廠。

e.b: A handful of shops, all capacity-constrained.
e.zt: 無人載具等級的元件與廠級維修
e.zb: 少數幾家維修廠，量能都有限。

e.b: Nobody packages it; each maker builds it ad hoc.
e.zt: 具出口管制意識的營運
e.zb: 沒有人整合提供；每家製造商各自臨時建立。

e.b: Patent firms paid by filing count; no UV-specialised advisor.
e.zb: 依申請件數收費的專利事務所；沒有專精無人載具的顧問。

e.b: No intermediary.
e.zb: 沒有中介。

e.t: Scope the sustainment before your systems arrive.
e.b: Scoping takes 6–10 weeks. NDA available.
e.zt: 在系統抵達之前，先完成維運的範疇評估。
e.zb: 範疇評估需時 6–10 週。可簽署保密協議。

e.t: Taiwan's ecosystem partner for unmanned‑vehicle makers
e.b: We hold the contract, run the program and own the SLA. Partners bring service capacity, UV capability and patent data.
e.zt: 無人載具製造商在台灣的生態系夥伴
e.zb: 我們持有合約、統籌專案並負責 SLA；夥伴提供服務量能、無人載具能力與專利資料。

e.b: Foreign makers will field systems in Taiwan that need local sustainment, and 9 of 16 leading foreign UAV makers hold no Taiwan patents.
e.zt: 為何是台灣，為何是現在
e.zb: 外國製造商將在台灣部署需要在地維運的系統，而主要外國無人機製造商，16 家中有 9 家在台灣沒有任何專利。

e.b: TIS also holds a UAV patent portfolio with Innovue. We tell you where our patents are before you hire us, and we will never use them against you while you are our customer.
e.zb: TIS 也與 Innovue 共同持有一組無人機專利組合。委託之前，我們先告訴您我們的專利在哪裡；您是我們客戶的期間，我們絕不以它們對付您。

e.b: We show you the portfolio's technical fields before an advisory engagement starts.
e.zb: 顧問合作開始前，我們先向您揭露專利組合的技術領域。

e.b: Before a retainer starts, we map your product fields against the portfolio. Where they overlap, you choose how to proceed.
e.zb: 顧問約開始前，我們將您的產品領域與專利組合比對。若有重疊，由您決定如何進行。

e.b: We do not assert portfolio patents against our advisory or MRO customers.
e.zb: 我們不對顧問或 MRO 客戶主張專利組合中的專利。

e.b: The advisory team never sees licensing negotiations, and your confidential information is never used for filings or licensing.
e.zb: 顧問團隊不接觸授權談判，您的機密資訊也絕不用於申請或授權策略。

e.b: TIS never takes ownership of your patents. Inventions from an engagement are yours, or held jointly with your right of first refusal.
e.zb: TIS 從不取得您專利的所有權。合作中產生的發明歸您所有，或共同持有並由您享有優先承購權。

e.b: Licences and MRO contracts are offered, contracted and invoiced separately, and no licence is priced against MRO volume.
e.zb: 授權與 MRO 合約分開提供、分開簽約、分開開立發票，授權價格也不參照 MRO 量。

e.b: Request a scoping conversation. NDA available.
e.zb: 預約範疇評估會談。可簽署保密協議。
